program_text='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the rare colored shape onto every matching all-zero footprint."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    if not coords:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in coords)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in coords)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in coords]
    dh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    dw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - dh + 1):
        for c in range(w - dw + 1):
            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
